sents.text: Ultimate Mortal Combat three. Scorpion versus Sub-Zero.
The two rivals face off in the Netherrealm. Destined enemies meet once again.
Scorpion strikes first! He hurls his spear, catching Sub-Zero off guard.
Sub-Zero counters with a blast of ice, freezing Scorpion solid!
A fierce exchange! Scorpion unleashes a rapid combo, driving Sub-Zero back.
Then he vanishes in a burst of flame, and reappears right behind him!
The uppercut! A rising strike launches Sub-Zero into the air.
Victory! Scorpion wins. Who is your pick? Comment below, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse.
